items.q: Ah, Django, that was the first time we ran into a real terrific guitar player.

ctx.x: Ah, Django, that was the first time

we ran into a real terrific guitar player. Django didn't have but three fingers. Yeah, he had three fingers and he would impossible things with those three fingers on guitar. But he was from -- he was a gypsy, really. So he didn't stay over here very long, just made a tour or two but he stayed mostly in France, Paris, but he was very terrific, too.
